findings.highlight: The swords break each other and the shards are sent flying.
findings.evidenceJa: 互いの剣は相殺し、大気に破片をまき散らす。
findings.governingReading: The two blades neutralize one another, scattering fragments into the air.
findings.explanation: “Break each other” replaces mutual cancellation with reciprocal weapon destruction.

findings.highlight: Overestimate yourself, kid!
findings.evidenceJa: 乗るなというのだ、小僧
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh’s interrupted sentence resolves as “Damn you—don’t get carried away, boy!”
findings.explanation: The idiom and interruption become an ungrammatical command to not overestimate oneself.

findings.highlight: I crash my swords against the appearing Noble Phantasms.
findings.evidenceJa: 矢継ぎ早に現れる宝具に剣を合わせる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou matches blades against Noble Phantasms appearing in rapid succession.
findings.explanation: The attack’s defining rapid succession disappears.

findings.highlight: I will keep moving forward now. That’s why I will keep moving forward.
findings.evidenceJa: 今は前に進むだけだ。
findings.governingReading: Right now, all he can do is keep moving forward.
findings.explanation: mirror moon duplicates the same proposition and invents a causal link between the copies.

findings.highlight: am I being cornered by such a sham
findings.evidenceJa: 押されているのか、この我が、このような贋作に
findings.governingReading: Am I—*I*—being driven back by a counterfeit like this?
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s incredulous emphasis on his royal self disappears at a central injury to his pride.

findings.highlight: He cannot handle my attacks and has to destroy my weapon with his.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツは俺の一撃を捌ききれず、その宝具を相殺させる。
findings.governingReading: Unable to parry Shirou’s blow completely, Gilgamesh has his Noble Phantasm neutralize it.
findings.explanation: Exact singular attack, failed parry, and reciprocal cancellation become plural attacks and destruction of Shirou’s weapon.

findings.highlight: He is the greatest heroic spirit, as he has over a thousand Noble Phantasms at his leisure.
findings.evidenceJa: ギルガメッシュの器の大きさは、紛れもなく英霊の中でも頂点に位置するものだ。
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh’s capacity—able to possess and handle more than a thousand Noble Phantasms—stands unquestionably at the summit even among Heroic Spirits.
findings.explanation: A specific judgment of his capacity becomes the much broader claim that he is simply the greatest Heroic Spirit.

findings.highlight: has over a thousand Noble Phantasms at his leisure
findings.evidenceJa: 千を超える宝具を持ち、その全てを扱う
findings.governingReading: possesses more than a thousand Noble Phantasms and can handle all of them
findings.explanation: “At his leisure” adds ease and nonchalance absent from the capability statement.

findings.highlight: He does not have one weapon, so he is not a “wielder” who can use his weapon to its maximum potential.
findings.evidenceJa: たった一つの宝具しか持たぬが故、それを極限まで使いこなす“担い手”ではない。
findings.governingReading: Because he is not limited to possessing a single Noble Phantasm, he is not a wielder who has mastered that one weapon to its utmost limit.
findings.explanation: The crucial owner-versus-wielder causality is left grammatically opaque and sounds as if Gilgamesh possesses no single weapon at all.

findings.highlight: I cannot match the ultimate one even with infinite swords.
findings.evidenceJa: 究極の一を持った敵には対抗できない。
findings.governingReading: Even infinite swords cannot contend with an enemy who possesses one ultimate weapon.
findings.explanation: “The ultimate one” obscures that the phrase describes the opponent’s singular supreme weapon.

findings.highlight: Gilgamesh must have the ability, but I do not.
findings.evidenceJa: それだけの身体能力が俺にはない。
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh may possess it, but Shirou lacks the necessary physical ability.
findings.explanation: The explicit bodily limit preventing Shirou from exploiting such a weapon becomes an unspecified lack of “ability.”

findings.highlight: this is the only Servant I can match.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が肉薄できる相手はこの男のみ。
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh is the only Servant Shirou can press this closely.
findings.explanation: A narrowly tactical ability to close on Gilgamesh becomes general equality with him.

findings.highlight: Gilgamesh raises his hand.
findings.evidenceJa: ギルガメッシュの腕が動く。
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh’s arm moves.
findings.explanation: The moving arm is narrowed to a raised hand immediately before the disputed arm-and-sword action.

findings.highlight: The sword appearing behind him
findings.evidenceJa: その背後に現れた剣の柄
findings.governingReading: the hilt of the sword that appears behind him
findings.explanation: The visible hilt—the part Gilgamesh is about to seize—disappears from the setup.

findings.highlight: I swing my twin swords.
findings.evidenceJa: 走る双剣。
findings.governingReading: The twin blades race forth.
findings.explanation: The weapons’ sudden rushing motion becomes a generic deliberate swing.

findings.highlight: sword falls
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツは愛剣を失い
findings.governingReading: He loses his beloved sword.
findings.explanation: The written epithet marking Gilgamesh’s exceptional attachment to this sword disappears again.

findings.highlight: to the ground, leaving him defenseless.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツは愛剣を失い、完全に無防備となっている。
findings.governingReading: Having lost his beloved sword, he is left completely defenseless.
findings.explanation: The source states loss and resulting total exposure; the English supplies an unmentioned fall to the ground.

findings.highlight: slash the king of heroes
findings.evidenceJa: その体を両断する！
findings.governingReading: cleave the King of Heroes’ body in two
findings.explanation: The intended bodily bisection that the next page narrowly averts becomes a generic slash.

findings.highlight: Gilgamesh admits his defeat and tries to retreat.
findings.evidenceJa: ギルガメッシュは離脱する。
findings.governingReading: Acknowledging defeat in this arena, Gilgamesh disengages.
findings.explanation: An action already underway is reduced to an attempt, weakening the pursuit trigger.

findings.highlight: “I won’t let you escape.” I won’t let him escape.
findings.evidenceJa: 「逃がすかってんだ」
findings.governingReading: “Like hell I’ll let you escape.”
findings.explanation: mirror moon repeats Shirou’s refusal as a second narration sentence.

findings.highlight: I have to settle the match right here!
findings.evidenceJa: この熱が冷めないうちに付けなくては！
findings.governingReading: He must settle it here before this heat and momentum cool.
findings.explanation: The time-sensitive condition behind Shirou’s pursuit disappears.

findings.highlight: “Dammit!”
findings.evidenceJa: 「このヤロウ！」
findings.governingReading: “You bastard!”
findings.explanation: A shout directed at Gilgamesh becomes an undirected curse.

findings.highlight: he pulls out a Noble Phantasm from behind him
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツは残った腕で背後から宝具を引き出す。
findings.governingReading: He draws a Noble Phantasm from behind him with his remaining arm.
findings.explanation: The explicit “remaining arm” continuity disappears, concealing the branch-sensitive bodily state.

findings.highlight: The light coming from the lake
findings.evidenceJa: 背後[line3]池の方から走り抜けた閃光
findings.governingReading: A flash races through from behind him, from the direction of the lake.
findings.explanation: The flash’s path from behind Shirou disappears.

findings.highlight: But after the Reality Marble is blown away…
findings.evidenceJa: だがその後。
findings.governingReading: But then—afterward.
findings.explanation: The English repeats the prior cause and resolves the deliberately suspended “afterward” before the black hole appears.

findings.highlight: His body is being swallowed.
findings.evidenceJa: その体が、めくれていく。
findings.governingReading: His body begins to peel or turn open.
findings.explanation: A grotesque physical transformation is prematurely replaced by the later act of consumption.

findings.highlight: is swallowed by the void appearing on his body
findings.evidenceJa: 自らに空いた穴に、内側から呑まれていた。
findings.governingReading: is swallowed from within by the hole opened in his own body
findings.explanation: The defining inside-out direction of Gilgamesh’s consumption disappears.

findings.highlight: the after-effect created the black void to eliminate Gilgamesh
findings.evidenceJa: この黒い孔が現れ、ヤツは消え去ったとしか考えられない。
findings.governingReading: the effect caused this black hole to appear, and Gilgamesh consequently vanished
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative causal reconstruction is turned into a purposeful mechanism created in order to eliminate Gilgamesh.

findings.highlight: since Saber went to go save her
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが行ってくれたんだから
findings.governingReading: since Saber went to her
findings.explanation: The English adds that Saber specifically went to rescue Rin, strengthening Shirou’s limited knowledge of events.

findings.highlight: I’m sure she’ll be all right
findings.evidenceJa: 今頃ぴんしゃんしてるとは思う
findings.governingReading: I imagine she is already back on her feet and perfectly lively
findings.explanation: Shirou’s colloquial picture of Rin being briskly healthy becomes generic survival or safety.

findings.highlight: I gasp.
findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸が止まる。
findings.governingReading: His breathing stops.
findings.explanation: A sudden cessation of breath becomes an intake of breath, reversing the physical action.

findings.highlight: My feet slide across the ground towards the void
findings.evidenceJa: 踏ん張った足は地面ごと、ズルズルとあの孔へと近づいていく
findings.governingReading: Even his braced feet, together with the ground beneath them, scrape steadily toward the hole.
findings.explanation: The English removes both Shirou’s bracing resistance and the chain dragging the ground itself.

findings.highlight: fool
findings.evidenceJa: あの出来損ないめ
findings.governingReading: that defective failure
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s contempt is aimed at the malformed Grail or hole; the English instead calls an unspecified person a fool.

findings.highlight: Does it not know Servants cannot become the core
findings.evidenceJa: 同じサーヴァントでは核にならんとさえ判らぬか
findings.governingReading: Does it not even understand that another being of the same Servant kind cannot serve as its core?
findings.explanation: The specific incompatibility of taking another Servant as the core becomes a blanket claim that Servants cannot be cores.

findings.highlight: He’s appearing from the void.
findings.evidenceJa: 孔から這い出たソレ
findings.governingReading: The thing that crawls out of the hole
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s degraded, desperate crawl is reduced to neutral appearance.

findings.highlight: He’s arrogant even in this situation
findings.evidenceJa: この期におよんでまだそんな王様発言を
findings.governingReading: Even now, at this stage, he is still making pronouncements like some king.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s specifically exasperated reaction to Gilgamesh’s kingly mode of speech becomes generic arrogance.
